searchDefinition.unit: whole furnished unit, studio or 1 bedroom
searchDefinition.stay: move-in by 2027-01-26 (within 2 months of collection) for a 1-3 month stay
searchDefinition.neighbourhoodRule: declared before collecting. Enforced by portal filter where the portal has one (casa.sapo); otherwise the stated neighbourhood is recorded and inDeclaredNeighbourhoods flags it, but listings are not dropped for it.

EUR.source: open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD (the feed the cost-evidence store cites)
EUR.note: the app's own ECB table (src/lib/fxRates.json, 2026-10-02) gives 0.8909 EUR per USD, about 2.4% fewer dollars per euro

portals.sort: portal default ('Recommended sorting'; includes 'Top pick' promotion). The 'newest' sort is a form control we could not set by URL.
portals.filters: none by URL; studio/1-bedroom whole apartments kept by reading each card
portals.note: Flatio cannot filter by neighbourhood, so the whole city result list was taken. Only 15-19 of the 34 cards per page rendered for us (the rest stayed as loading placeholders), so this is the rendered part of each page, in order. Cards that are rooms, houses or 2+ bedrooms were skipped by definition and are not listed. 0 card(s) changed between our two page views and had no snapshot, so they are left out. Medellín has 36 listings in total (2 pages); later page numbers repeat page 1 and were ignored.
